title: A Novel Space-Time Transport Ratio for Analyzing Field Dynamics
content: We introduce a new dimensionless parameter, the Space-Time Transport Ratio, used to measure coupling between advective transport and intrinsic temporal evolution of general fields along space-time. Born out of the material derivative and constrained by the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality, the ratio provides a local characterization of the manner spatial gradients couple with velocity fields to create changes in scalar or vector fields. We discuss its mathematical structure, interpretations, and possible uses in fluid dynamics and other fields and recommend it as an analysis tool for transport-dominated regimes of physical systems. The recommendation deepens traditional notions in continuum mechanics, giving new insights into the tapestry of space-time interactions in non-relativistic systems.
